name: rhino
description_en: Rhino is an open-source implementation of JavaScript written entirely in Java
readme_excerpt: Rhino: JavaScript in Java Rhino is an implementation of JavaScript in Java. License Rhino is licensed under the MPL 2.0. Summary Rhino requires Java 17 or higher to run, and 21 or higher to build. Java 25 is highly recommended. To build and run a Rhino shell: ./gradlew run -q --console=plain To run the tests: git submodule init git submodule update ./gradlew check Releases The current release is Rhino 1.9.1 .
